data.gender_notes: Rogerio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Roverius, meaning 'from the river' or 'settler by the river'. The name Rogerio carries the meaning “Man from Roverius” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rogerio usually hope their child will grow to embody man from roverius and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rogerio total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: רוגריו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'rog' (to yoke or to be exalted) and 'yio' (God). It can be interpreted as 'exalted or strong one of God' or 'the one who is exalted by God'.

in_greek.name: Ρωγεριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Rogerius, which itself comes from the Old French name Roger. The Greek form is a direct translation of the Latin name.

in_latin.name: Rogerius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Old French name Roger, which comes from the Germanic name Hrodgar or Hröðgar, meaning 'hale, strong, or famous'. The Latin name Rogerius is a Latinized form of this Old Germanic name.

in_english.name: Rogerio
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name Hrocger, which means 'hale-man' or 'strong spear'. The modern English name Roger is a shortened form of this Old English name.

data.cultural_impact: In various parts of the world, the name Rogerio is a common Portuguese and Brazilian name. Being from the Latin origin, it represents a strong connection to European heritage. It is also associated with historical figures such as Roger de Lauria, a medieval Spanish naval commander, who made significant contributions to European history.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rogerio is derived from its rooted meaning, 'settler by the river'. The name can be seen as a reminder of God's provision and support in our lives. Just as the settler relies on the river for sustenance, believers can lean on their faith and trust that God will provide for their needs. Moreover, the name can also be interpreted as 'strong by the river', symbolizing the strength and resilience that comes from faith in God during life's tumultuous moments.
